bugs.evidence: HTTP PATCH /api/incidents/{id} with ADMIN session returned 500 Internal Server Error after a newly created high-risk detection. Backend log reports PydanticSerializationError: Unable to serialize unknown type bson.objectid.ObjectId. Browser incident-status-update reached the control but emitted the same 500 console error.

action_items: Fix incident update response serialization so the updated incident excludes or stringifies Mongo ObjectId values, then rerun backend incident and browser checks.
